title: Peak net L5/S1 moment during symmetric 10 kg lifts from knee/ankle height, near/far, no exoskeleton

quantity.name: peak L5S1 net flexion-extension moment (ML5S1_total)
quantity.definition: bottom-up inverse dynamics, peak over lift, mean ± SD (error bars assumed SD)

source.authors: Koopman AS, Kingma I, de Looze MP, van Dieën JH
source.sample: 11 healthy male subjects (same cohort/ethics protocol NL57404.029.16 and identical demographics as Koopman 2019)

protocol.summary: Symmetric lifting of a 10 kg box (35 x 10 x 25 cm, w x h x d) from 10 cm above ankle height (ANKLE) or 10 cm above knee height (KNEE), box centre 35 cm (NEAR) or 60 cm (FAR) in front of the ankle joint; start and end upright without box; free (self-selected) speed and technique; 3 repetitions; WITHOUT exoskeleton condition only. Peak values over the lift.
how_to_simulate: Scale model to a 184 cm, 74.8 kg male
Simulate symmetric 10 kg lifts from the 4 locations with measured peak lumbar flexion and trunk velocity
Compare peak net L5-S1 extension moment

subject_model.source: Koopman 2020a Methods 2.3 (mean of 11 males; 1.84 ± 0.07 m, 74.8 ± 7.4 kg)

protocol.notes: WITHOUT means printed on Fig. 3 bars: peak lumbar flexion KN 31, KF 38, AN 48, AF 56 deg (SD digitised ~5/10/11/10); peak trunk angular velocity KN 157, KF 180, AN 216, AF 232 deg/s.

data.load: 10 kg; 10 cm above knee; 35 cm in front of ankle
10 kg; 10 cm above knee; 60 cm in front of ankle
10 kg; 10 cm above ankle; 35 cm in front of ankle
10 kg; 10 cm above ankle; 60 cm in front of ankle

extraction.from: Fig. 3 'Total moment L5S1' NO EXO bars (means printed)
extraction.uncertainty: means printed (±0.5 Nm); SD digitised ±3 Nm
extraction.check_notes: Off-centre pixel bar top for KN = 169.9 Nm vs label 170. SD caps 193.2/256.8/243.2/305.5 Nm minus means.
